task: Annotation-conditioned true-versus-training-rival PRISM AUC contrast; canonical pair orientation; previously exposed fold0 only. Not blind mechanism discovery, independent confirmation or STATE validation.
hypothesis: An honest fixed-world policy with exact finite-family LTT can retain useful coverage at marginal wrong-decision risk <=0.05; conditional risk is a separate, stricter endpoint.
split: Outer fold0 evaluation intact; remaining unique connectivity units sorted by SHA256(viability-contrast-9|split|unit), first half proper-training and remainder calibration. All fitted templates, rank, blend weight, basis, tau and rivals use only proper-training. Same frozen fit on calibration and evaluation; never refit on calibration.
unsupported: Keep every calibration/evaluation unit. No training-supported rival means explicit abstention, zero decisions and zero measurements. Report support coverage separately.
world: Existing world5b low-rank response completion proxy; no new STATE inference. Clipped LMM retained solely as working score, not normalized LR/test martingale.
qc: Missing purchases charged; QC reported only through stopping prefix.
thresholds: 21 geometric values from0.5 through64. First +/- crossing; a separate None sentinel always abstains. Acquisition simulated once to fullbudget; stopping prefix determines actual charge.

risk_control.method: One-sided exact Clopper-Pearson bounds with Bonferroni across3 policies x21 thresholds x2 endpoints. Certified marginal upper(wrong,n)<=alpha; certified conditional upper(wrong,decided)<=alpha. No decisions cannot certify conditional risk. Choose maximum calibration decision count among certified thresholds, smaller threshold tie-break. No certified threshold=>explicit abstention.
risk_control.assumptions: Conditional on fixed proper training, independent identically distributed calibration and deployment units are required for exact binomial risk claims. Existing class-stratified exposed folds may violate this deployment assumption; guarantees remain conditional on it and no new independent scientific validation is claimed.
risk_control.capacity: 126-family certification at5% needs153 zero-error trials. Half split retains200 calibration units before any support restriction; conditional needs153 actual decisions.

pilot_gate: ginfo marginal must have a certified calibration threshold, heldout coverage >=0.20, wrong/n<=0.05 and descriptive one-sided95% bound<=0.15. This is an exploratory pilot progression criterion, not5% heldout certification. Global5folds only if gate passes, with unchanged protocol.
primary_outputs: calibration.json committed before reading evaluation trajectories
interpretation: A 0.070 rate in115 trials is not proof of0.02 distribution shift; nonmonotone loss invalidates prior CRC; greedy oracle and plug-in separation are not impossibility bounds. Do not rescue failure by test-outcome threshold tuning, changing denominator, density weights without assumptions, or refitting after calibration.
production: No src/tools changes or promotion; preserve prior freezes. No paid API or additional biological data needed.
